title: A11y Standards
summary: Standardized component access and implementation guidelines, dropping performance and accessibility errors by 37 %.

body.context: Legacy feature views averaged 30 flagged issues in Lighthouse, axe-core, and Chromatic audits.
body.contribution: Embedded pre-tested ARIA patterns and optimized asset pipelines into the core components, plus implementation guidelines.
body.outcome: Teams inherit compliant code by default. Flagged issues dropped from 30 to 19.
